title: HealthResponse
description: Response schema for GET /health (v3 — adds circuit_breakers from spec 005)

status.description: ok = all core circuits closed; degraded = at least one core circuit (github/agent/anthropic) open; unhealthy = daemon stopped

phase.description: Current coordinare workflow phase (from spec 003 WorkflowSnapshot)

snapshot_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last persisted WorkflowSnapshot (from spec 003)

circuit_breakers.description: Current circuit breaker state per service

active_card_id.description: Board card ID currently being processed, if any

state.description: closed = normal; open = calls blocked; half_open = single probe in progress

opened_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when circuit was last opened (null when closed)

failure_count.description: Number of exhausted retry budgets within the current observation window
